input.quote: (a) This Agreement is governed in all respects by the laws of the State of Delaware without giving effect to its conflict of laws principles. Each Party hereby irrevocably submits for all disputes to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of the state and federal courts located in New York, New York.
input.rationale: Section 14(a) selects Delaware law (fallback-only) while fixing venue in New York courts, so law and forum are mismatched. Our preferred position is New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, which is achieved by a one-word substitution while leaving the venue sentence otherwise intact. Venue is already domestic courts and the Section 8 AAA arbitration clause has no foreign seat, so no walk-away trigger; we flag the arbitration/exclusive-venue conflict in the comment only rather than expanding the redline.

ops.oldText: the laws of the State of Delaware
ops.newText: the laws of the State of New York

ops.oldText: the state and federal courts located in New York, New York
ops.newText: the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We moved governing law to New York so it matches the agreed New York venue, and confirmed exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County. If you prefer, we can accept Delaware or California law and courts as a fallback, but law and forum should be aligned; please also confirm that Section 8 arbitration is subordinate to this exclusive court venue and, if retained, is seated in New York.
proposal.summary: Change governing law from Delaware to New York and confirm New York County venue.
